name: Agency founder
description: For founders of service agencies (marketing, design, development, automation) who sell retainers and projects to other businesses. Leans on case studies, behind-the-build content and sharp industry takes.
forWho: Marketing, creative and growth agency founders
Development, automation and AI implementation studios
Productised service businesses selling to other businesses

evidence.claim: Buyers of agency services check the founder's content before a sales call.
evidence.note: Common in practitioner reports; track 'saw your content' in your own call notes to confirm.

evidence.claim: Showing real work (screens, dashboards, the build) earns more qualified leads than generic tips.
evidence.note: Directional. Verify with the learn module's lane comparison after about 20 posts.

evidence.claim: On personal LinkedIn profiles, text and document posts reach more people than video.
